analysis.file_name: GS Blekos - ## FED 3x Hikes Siemens Energy Zalando On ConvaTec WOSG Enagas Consumer & Nielsen Talanx Coreweave ## 11 Nov 2026.pdf
analysis.title: FED 3x Hikes / Siemens Energy / Zalando / On / ConvaTec / WOSG / Enagas / Consumer & Nielsen / Talanx / Coreweave
key_insights: GS adds a third 25bp Fed rate hike in March 2027 to its forecast, after October CPI surprised to the upside across several categories and marked a third month of worse inflation news.

GS still expects a second 25bp hike in December. A third hike could come in January, but GS thinks March is more likely because it expects softer November and December inflation reports followed by larger start-of-year price increases that lift January inflation.

Siemens Energy's announced buyback implies EUR27bn of returns of value (buyback plus dividends) out to FY 2030, versus Visible Alpha at EUR24bn and GSe at EUR30bn. GS expects the Capital Markets Day to show a stronger profit outlook and a material acceleration in cash flow, and remains Buy rated (on Conviction List).
Siemens Energy's current capital allocation out to FY 2028 is 1/3 of cash flow to capex, 1/3 to returns of value and 1/3 retained. GS expects this to change once guidance extends to FY 2030.

Zalando CFO meeting: autumn/winter trading on track after a good start to 4Q. Overlap across the three B2C apps is limited at 10%, management is confident in the 3-4% retail media target by 2028, and Scayle's B2B pipeline is full.

Zalando management reiterated its 6-8% 2028 adj. EBIT margin target, built on a flat gross margin, overhead efficiencies, logistics network reshaping and payment/commercial buying synergies from merging AY and Zalando.

On Holding 3Q26: cFX sales +17.8% yoy, underlying gross margin +320bps yoy, adj. EBITDA margin 21.9% excluding tariff refunds. US wholesale sell-out improved versus 2Q, partner inventories are healthy, and the Cloud Surfer 3 launch with run specialty partners has shown strong early signals. GS stays Buy and cuts its 12m TP to $41 from $44.

On's share of online customers under 24 almost doubled yoy. GS cites 2027 growth levers: a refreshed running franchise with new superfoams, entry into Football and Golf, sneaker share gains and a growing apparel line from a low base.
ConvaTec: GS reiterates Buy with PT unchanged at 300p. It sees multiple upside and mid-teens EPS growth over 12 months if the company delivers accelerating growth and handles cost inflation.

Watches of Switzerland 1H27 trading update: group revenue GBP974mn, +15% cFX, versus GSe GBP946mn and Visible Alpha consensus GBP941mn. US revenue +22% cFX to GBP501mn, UK +9% to GBP473mn. GS PT 930p (from 920p), Buy.

Watches of Switzerland expects 1H27 pre-IFRS adjusted EBIT of GBP87-89mn (about +28%, margin +80-100bps). It raised the low end of FY27 guidance: cFX revenue growth 7-10% (was 5-10%) and pre-IFRS 16 adj. EBIT margin expansion 60-80bps (was 40-80bps).
Enagas: GS says structural headwinds still outweigh the positives and remains Sell.

CoreWeave 3Q26: shares +8% after hours. Revenue was 3% above the Street and EBIT margin 350bps above (Visible Alpha). 4Q implied revenue guidance is 3% above the Street, margins 100bps above and capex 22% below.

CoreWeave's financing plan: no additional parent-level unsecured debt through 2027. Most remaining capital needs are to be funded through DDTLs that can finance 70%-100% of associated capex at 7-10% yields.
Other items in the note with no detail in the text: Europe consumer products US Nielsen data (Beiersdorf subdued, Cold/Flu accelerating in Consumer Health) and a Talanx 3Q'26 earnings preview.

Watches of Switzerland 1H27 trading update, reported: group revenue GBP974mn (+15% cFX) versus GSe GBP946mn and Visible Alpha consensus GBP941mn. Guidance for 1H27 pre-IFRS adj. EBIT is GBP87-89mn.

macro_indicators.reading: Surprised meaningfully to the upside across several categories
macro_indicators.interpretation: Third month of worse inflation news, which led GS to add a third Fed hike.

macro_indicators.reading: Second 25bp hike in December 2026 and a third 25bp hike in March 2027
macro_indicators.interpretation: GS sees further tightening. January is possible for the third hike but March is more likely.

macro_indicators.reading: Softer November and December reports, then larger price increases in January 2027
macro_indicators.interpretation: Start-of-year price increases amid ongoing cost pressures are expected to lift January inflation.

risk_factors: Ongoing cost pressures could push inflation higher at the start of 2027, which would pull the third Fed hike earlier to January.
A promotional sportswear market is a backdrop for On.
ConvaTec needs to execute on accelerating growth and navigate cost inflation for the multiple to rerate.
